tha-ap433:2.3: suññatābahulo tādī → suññatabahulo tādi (sya-all); puññatābahulo tādi (pts) | puññatā-bahulo → S1 suññatā-. (pts note)

tha-ap433:6.3: mahāduggā → mahādukkhā (sya-all) | mahāduggā → G. mahādukkhā. (pts note)
tha-ap433:6.4: vippanaṭṭhe → vipannaddhe (bj) | vipannaddhe → vippanaṭṭho (bj: sīmu, machasaṁ)

tha-ap433:8.4: vasiṁ → S1 vasī; G. vasi. (pts note)
